forces.title: Rising Therapies and Diseases Squeeze Managed Care Budgets
forces.description: Managed Care & Payers, including MCOs and health benefits administrators, face significant budget pressure. A swelling pipeline of increasingly tailored therapies, rising disease awareness, and a population needing more care are collectively squeezing payers' and plan sponsors' budgets everywhere. This financial constraint necessitates innovative cost management and value demonstration from these entities.
forces.source_title: Why Pharma Transformations Stall—and How to Fix Them

forces.title: Managed Care Drives Operational Redesign in Pharmaceutical Sector
forces.description: The influence of managed care, alongside the Internet and data revolution, is a fundamental force compelling pharmaceutical companies to redesign their traditional operating models. Managed Care & Payers are exerting unprecedented pressure on pricing, access, and the evidence required for therapies, effectively forcing pharma to innovate operationally. This reflects a growing and critical role for managed care in shaping the broader healthcare ecosystem.
